title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-11
lineage: (9th row - center) Senn 421's > Sony TC D5 > Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x1) >EAC >SHN (tracking with CDWAV)

ai_review.summary: A decent audience tape of the 04‑11‑1982 show captures mixed energy, with Let It Grow and Franklin’s Tower shining despite early set hiccups.
ai_review.review: The recording is a listenable audience capture that suffers from some bumps and early‑set clarity issues but improves as the concert progresses. Musically the night is uneven – the first set starts shaky while the second delivers highlights like Let It Grow, Franklin's Tower, El Paso and a strong Candyman, though other moments (Good Lovin', Half‑Step) feel lackluster.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between praise for standout songs and criticism of both performance lapses and recording imperfections, yielding an overall average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall listenable with a solid mid‑range balance; early set openings are muddy with occasional dropouts, lyric bleed‑through and equipment bumps, but later songs sound clearer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set opens shaky with a flubbed Half‑Step but recovers toward the end; the second set is praised for its sparkle by some reviewers while others feel it collapses after a weak Good Lovin' moment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewers note his relaxed vibe, hot licks, a flubbed line on Half‑Step but strong solos and soulful vocals on Candyman.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's extended high organ note in Around (and scat‑sing on Rooster) is highlighted; his keyboard work adds color.
